prerequisites: Student has a basic knowledge of mathematics and physics.
Student has the ability to read drawings and diagrams contained in the technical documentation.
Student has basic knowledge in the design of machine elements. It has a basic knowledge of manufacturing techniques of machine parts.

learning_outcomes.text: Able to identify and define the quantity of the measuring machine parts. He knows and is able to determine the arrangements for ensuring the measurement integrity.
Can name the elements of the measurement system and define its functional characteristics. He knows the characteristic values measured in different types of machines.
He knows the principles governing the creation of tools, components and measuring systems in dependence of production lot scale.

Understand the dimensional requirements imposed to products included in the technical documentation. Can use literature related to the assessment of the geometry of the product. Can calculate the value of measurement errors, estimated measurement uncertainty for the different measurements.
He can make the selection of appropriate test equipment and set it up depending on the task measuring. Can create documents for the implementation of the measurements on the test bench.
Can use industrial measuring equipment management systems.
Search for information and its critical analysis
Team collaboration on improving the method of selection of strategies aimed at optimal solution entrusted of problems to a group.
Objective evaluation of arguments, the rational explanation of his own point of view using the knowledge of metrology.

syllabus_topics: Organizational matters. Basic concepts of metrology. Quantities and units of measurement. Integrated measurement units. SI units, measurement standards, measurement itegrity.
Elements of measurenment systems and their properties.
The method of determining the measurement uncertainty.
Distribution of the variability of dimensions for typical processes.
Toleration of machines in various technological processes.
Designing of measuring devices's heads.
Design and control tests for checking the geometry of the product.
Integration of measuring stands.
Mechanization and automation of measurement processes.
Methods of measurement systems analysis.
Methods and tools for monitoring measurement equipment.
Elements of statistical control of manufacturing processes.
Organization and documentation of the process control of machines.
Analysis of tolerance and interchangeability of parts.
Organizational matters. General principles for the use of measuring equipment.
Checking selected metrological characteristics of measuring instruments.
Selection of equipment for specific measurement tasks.
Analysis of the measurement system.
Measurement with pneumatic methods
Analysis of the measurement system.
Measurement in the integrated measurement environment.
Analysis and implementation of the CMM measurement tasks.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: The concluding grade for lectures (P) is based on the test (F1). The concluding grade for laboratory exercises (P) is the average of all grades (F1) which include reports on laboratory exercises, tests, and oral answers.
